gameObjectiveDesc:
• Click on the appearing documents to destroy them!
• Smaller and faster documents give higher scores
• If too many documents pile up, the boss will appear... 😰
gameElementsDesc:
• 📄 Documents: Click to destroy and earn points
• 👨‍💼 Newbie: Click adds 5 documents (avoid!)
• 📧 Mail: Click to change jobs! Removes piled documents
gameTipsDesc:
• Click or tap documents to clear them!
• Use mail when documents pile up
• Press 'A' or tap 🤖 for AI, then move your mouse or drag your finger across documents
• Use ⏸ / ▶ to pause or resume
